{
  "candidate": "cand_0001",
  "headline": "Empty-seed init: code-enforce payment normalize/auto-correct + payment_history re-sync + enriched communicate returns, plus explicit mid-model prose for the stall/confirm and communicate clusters.",
  "clusters": [
    {"id": "A", "name": "Stall before write (USER_STOP)",
     "detail": "Agent describes the action, asks to confirm, yields its turn; the user simulator sends ###STOP### and the episode ends before any write. 7 zero-write trials.",
     "tasks": ["8", "19", "22", "23", "25", "40"], "scope": "SYSTEMIC", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "B", "name": "Payment format + wrong amount",
     "detail": "payment_methods=[{type,id}] -> 'payment_id Field required'; guessed/underpaid amounts (500 vs 348; 299 vs 375; cc mis-split).",
     "tasks": ["8", "23", "25"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"},
    {"id": "C", "name": "COMMUNICATE omission (DB ok, figure unspoken)",
     "detail": "Correct DB write but the required dollar figure (refund $5244 / total charged) never appears in the agent's text, zeroing the product score.",
     "tasks": ["11", "23"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "D", "name": "Wrong reservation + duplicate passenger",
     "detail": "Acts on UM3OG5 instead of the route-matching FQ8APE; adds a passenger causing 'Number of passengers does not match'.",
     "tasks": ["17", "22"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "E", "name": "Wrong tool / over- and under-action",
     "detail": "Transfers to human when an eligible write exists; cancels/rebooks beyond the request.",
     "tasks": ["12", "19", "37", "40"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "DECISION / PERMISSION"},
    {"id": "F", "name": "Baggage miscount (defensive)",
     "detail": "Not observed as a failure in these traces; deterministic nonfree recompute kept as a safe no-op that generalizes to unseen tasks.",
     "tasks": [], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": true, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"}
  ],
  "edits": [
    {"id": "E1", "title": "Payment-dict normalization (id->payment_id, drop type/source, default amount)",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["B"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "T8 malformed {type,id} dict booked at $348 against live DB; well-formed dict unchanged."},
    {"id": "E2", "title": "Payment auto-correct (single method / single credit card absorbs remainder) + payment_history re-sync",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["B", "C"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
     "verified": "T25 cc absorbs 171->247 (total 375, gift->0); correct booking = no-op; re-sync confirmed on stored reservation."},
    {"id": "E3", "title": "Enriched returns with exact payment_summary + communicate_to_user on all write tools",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "WIDE",
     "verified": "T11 return states refund $5244 (gold); dict serializes via Environment.to_json_str; returns not hashed = DB-safe."},
    {"id": "E4", "title": "Deterministic nonfree-baggage recompute + total_price>0 payment guard",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "CAPABILITY-GAP", "clusters": ["F"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "silver/business/3pax/total5 + nonfree=99 + empty payment_id -> recomputed 0, no payment error; no-op when correct."},
    {"id": "E5", "title": "Actionable update_reservation_passengers count-mismatch error",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["D"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "count mismatch raises error naming current count + 'modify in place' guidance."},
    {"id": "E6", "title": "RULE 1 confirm-once-then-execute (anti-stall) with worked right/wrong examples",
     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "WIDE",
     "verified": "prose; targets the 7 zero-write stall trials; softness clause permits judgement."},
    {"id": "E7", "title": "RULE 2 state exact $ charged/refunded; RULE 3 baggage table; RULE 4 payment sums; RULE 5 disambiguate + act-vs-transfer + modify-in-place; RULE 6 softness",
     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "CONTRACT", "clusters": ["C", "D", "E", "F"], "blast_radius": "WIDE",
     "verified": "prose; general rules traced to policy + observed failures."}
  ],
  "skipped": [
    {"title": "Hardcoded reservation-id disambiguation (17/22)", "reason": "Would overfit; handled via prose + actionable error."},
    {"title": "Multi-certificate split auto-correct (23)", "reason": "No safe general 'which cert absorbs' rule; only single-method/single-cc handled."},
    {"title": "Task 19 trial 1", "reason": "Flagged infra noise (###STOP### + leaked reasoning); not optimizable."}
  ],
  "techniques": ["in-body validation/normalization guard", "in-body auto-correction fired only on mismatch", "latent-bug fix (payment_history re-sync)", "enriched DB-safe return values for COMMUNICATE", "actionable error messages", "deterministic policy recompute as no-op", "explicit mid-model prose rules with worked examples", "softness/judgement clause", "subagent fan-out for diagnosis", "live-DB verification of every code edit"]
}
